description: Ismail Industries Limited is one of Pakistan's larger food manufacturers, producing confectionery, biscuits, chips and flour among other products. Its SnackCity division began operations in June 2006 at a purpose-built facility in Hub with the launch of Kurleez potato chips, and its Ghiza Flour Mills wheat-milling business operates at Port Qasim.
sourceNote: Company website (ismailindustries.com home page), read 2026-10-17. The site does not publish a registered office address or telephone number on the pages read.
